visual_text: Active giant cell arteritis: start high-dose steroid immediately
High-dose steroid at once: 40 to 60 mg a day of prednisone or equivalent
Confirm the diagnosis by scan or biopsy
Authors of a Danish study advise prompt ultrasound, preferably within 3 days of starting steroid
Our view, not EULAR wording: we should not hold treatment for a scan slot.
Hellmich et al., EULAR 2018 update, Ann Rheum Dis 2020; Hansen et al., Rheumatology 2025
Temporal artery ultrasound picked up less after 10 days of steroids
48 people with newly diagnosed giant cell arteritis, Denmark. 95% confidence intervals 58 to 85 and 38 to 68. Small single-centre study.
alt_text: Flow for active giant cell arteritis: start high-dose steroid at once, confirm by scan or biopsy, early ultrasound within 3 days. Sight loss can be permanent. A note marks our view as ours, not EULAR wording.

Bar chart from a Danish study of 48 people: temporal artery ultrasound sensitivity 73 in 100 before steroids and 53 in 100 after 10 days, with confidence intervals 58 to 85 and 38 to 68. Small single-centre study.
